title: Wear 2.0 watch-face doesn't auto-update
body:
Due to issues with version handling on Wear 2.0 the xDrip watchface doesn't automatically keep in sync with the version installed on the phone. 

Plan to detect this within the watchface.

comments.body: 26th July nightly has some support for this on my demigod enabled watch roms,

@jamorham I hope you don't mind me closing this as it seems you are happy with the status.
But, please let me know if I should reopen.
